metadata.question: Did the sea surface temperatures in March 2022 at a location 100 km offshore east of Cairns, Australia, show temperature changes greater than 1°C compared to the overall average water temperatures from 2003 to 2014?

data.raw_code: 1. Masking strategy: - SST data typically has quality flags or missing values - Use .select('sst') and check for valid pixels - No cloud masking needed for ocean data, but check for missing/masked values 3. Logic: - Calculate March 2022 average SST - Calculate 2003-2014 overall average SST (all months) - Compare: if |difference| > 1°C, answer A; else B - Check for C1 (no data), C2 (no valid pixels), C3 (null/invalid results) ```python import ee ee.Initialize(project='earthsense-436113') # 1. Extract values at point sst_2022 = mean_2022.reduceRegion( reducer=ee.Reducer.mean(), geometry=point, scale=25000, maxPixels=1e9 ).get('sst').getInfo() sst_baseline = mean_baseline.reduceRegion( reducer=ee.Reducer.mean(), geometry=point, scale=25000, maxPixels=1e9 ).get('sst').getInfo() # Check pixel counts count_2022 = mean_2022.select('sst').reduceRegion( reducer=ee.Reducer.count(), geometry=point, scale=25000, maxPixels=1e9 ).get('sst').getInfo() count_baseline = mean_baseline.select('sst').reduceRegion( reducer=ee.Reducer.count(), geometry=point, scale=25000, maxPixels=1e9 ).get('sst').getInfo() print(f"Valid pixels 2022: {count_2022}, baseline: {count_baseline}") if count_2022 == 0 or count_baseline == 0: print("No valid pixels after processing.") print("C2") elif sst_2022 is None or sst_baseline is None: print("Calculation returned None.") print("C3") elif sst_2022 < -5 or sst_2022 > 50 or sst_baseline < -5 or sst_baseline > 50: print(f"Invalid temperature range: 2022={sst_2022}C, baseline={sst_baseline}C") print("C3") else: # SST in OISST is in Celsius difference = abs(sst_2022 - sst_baseline) print(f"March 2022 SST: {sst_2022:.2f}C") print(f"2003-2014 SST: {sst_baseline:.2f}C") print(f"Temperature difference: {difference:.2f}C") if difference > 1.0: print("A") else: print("B") ```

import ee
ee.Initialize(project='earthsense-436113')

# 1. Geometry & Time Definitions
# Cairns is approximately at -16.9°S, 145.8°E
# 100 km east: approximately 1 degree longitude at this latitude
cairns_lat = -16.9
cairns_lon = 145.8
offshore_lon = cairns_lon + 1.0  # ~100 km east
point = ee.Geometry.Point([offshore_lon, cairns_lat])

# 2. Data Acquisition
# Using NOAA OISST for reliable SST data
sst_collection = 'NOAA/CDR/OISST/V2_1'

# March 2022
col_2022 = ee.ImageCollection(sst_collection).filterDate('2022-03-01', '2022-04-01').filterBounds(point)
size_2022 = col_2022.size().getInfo()
print(f"March 2022 images: {size_2022}")

# 2003-2014 baseline (all months)
col_baseline = ee.ImageCollection(sst_collection).filterDate('2003-01-01', '2015-01-01').filterBounds(point)
size_baseline = col_baseline.size().getInfo()
print(f"2003-2014 images: {size_baseline}")

if size_2022 == 0 or size_baseline == 0:
    print("Missing data for one or both periods.")
    print("<answer>C1</answer>")
else:
    # 3. Processing
    # Calculate mean SST for March 2022
    mean_2022 = col_2022.select('sst').mean()
    
    # Calculate mean SST for 2003-2014
    mean_baseline = col_baseline.select('sst').mean()
    
    # 4. Extract values at point
    sst_2022 = mean_2022.reduceRegion(
        reducer=ee.Reducer.mean(),
        geometry=point,
        scale=25000,
        maxPixels=1e9
    ).get('sst').getInfo()
    
    sst_baseline = mean_baseline.reduceRegion(
        reducer=ee.Reducer.mean(),
        geometry=point,
        scale=25000,
        maxPixels=1e9
    ).get('sst').getInfo()
    
    # Check pixel counts
    count_2022 = mean_2022.select('sst').reduceRegion(
        reducer=ee.Reducer.count(),
        geometry=point,
        scale=25000,
        maxPixels=1e9
    ).get('sst').getInfo()
    
    count_baseline = mean_baseline.select('sst').reduceRegion(
        reducer=ee.Reducer.count(),
        geometry=point,
        scale=25000,
        maxPixels=1e9
    ).get('sst').getInfo()
    
    print(f"Valid pixels 2022: {count_2022}, baseline: {count_baseline}")
    
    if count_2022 == 0 or count_baseline == 0:
        print("No valid pixels after processing.")
        print("<answer>C2</answer>")
    elif sst_2022 is None or sst_baseline is None:
        print("Calculation returned None.")
        print("<answer>C3</answer>")
    elif sst_2022 < -5 or sst_2022 > 50 or sst_baseline < -5 or sst_baseline > 50:
        print(f"Invalid temperature range: 2022={sst_2022}C, baseline={sst_baseline}C")
        print("<answer>C3</answer>")
    else:
        # SST in OISST is in Celsius
        difference = abs(sst_2022 - sst_baseline)
        print(f"March 2022 SST: {sst_2022:.2f}C")
        print(f"2003-2014 SST: {sst_baseline:.2f}C")
        print(f"Temperature difference: {difference:.2f}C")
        
        if difference > 1.0:
            print("<answer>A</answer>")
        else:
            print("<answer>B</answer>")
